name: Cranial Technologies
desc:
Customer Service Representative - Parent Liaison | $18.50 - $19.00/hr | Inbound/Outbound, No Sales Expectations
Company: Cranial Technologies
Industry: Pediatric Healthcare / Medical Device Treatment
What Your Day Will Look Like:
 You'd be the friendly voice guiding families through the process of getting their baby treated for plagiocephaly, commonly called flat head syndrome. That means talking with parents, doctors, and insurance companies over the phone, entering patient registration and appointment details accurately, and helping families understand costs, co-pays, and their financial responsibility. You'd be handling a steady stream of calls, averaging 40 to 70 a day, all while making a genuinely stressful moment for a parent feel a little easier. It's compassionate, detail-driven work at a company that specializes in one very specific, meaningful area of pediatric care.
assessment: Expect a basic assessment, a typing test, and a home internet speed test, since the posting doesn't state otherwise.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
 Education Minimum: Not specified in the posting
Required Experience: 1 to 2 years of customer service or related experience, and 1 to 2 years of experience with computer software
Preferred Experience: Not specified beyond required experience
Required Skills:
Exceptional communication, including phone etiquette and interpersonal skills
Ability to work with people from diverse backgrounds
Proactive mindset with the ability to absorb new information quickly
Professional demeanor in both written and spoken communication
Ability to problem-solve and prioritize a busy daily workload
Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
Someone naturally warm and compassionate who wants to help families during a sensitive moment
Someone with 1 to 2 years of customer service experience and comfort with computer systems
Someone who can handle a high volume of calls, 40 to 70 a day, while staying calm and organized
Someone who enjoys coordinating between multiple parties, families, doctors, and insurance companies
Not a Good Fit for
Anyone under 1 to 2 years of customer service or computer software experience
Anyone who struggles with high call volume or juggling multiple queues at once
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Patient registration
Appointment scheduling
Insurance coordination
Pediatric healthcare
Customer service
Phone etiquette
Cost share and co-payment review
High call volume
Data entry
Family communication
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
Application
Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you
If the assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen
If the phone screen passes, expect a final interview
Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3 to 15 days on average.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about a time you went above and beyond for a customer. (Note: this is an actual application question on Cranial Technologies' form, worth preparing for directly.)
Walk us through how you'd explain insurance costs or co-payments to a worried parent.
How do you stay organized managing a high volume of calls across multiple queues?
What's your experience coordinating information between different parties, like providers and insurance companies?
How do you keep a compassionate tone with families while still moving efficiently through your daily workload?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $18.50 to $19.00 per hour, dependent on relevant experience
Shift: Full-time, specific hours not detailed in the posting
Benefits: Medical, vision, and dental insurance, 401k retirement plan, flex spending plans, 18 days of PTO plus 7 paid company holidays, life insurance, and short/long-term disability insurance
Equipment Provided: Not specified in the posting, and no internet requirement is listed either. Confirm both during the recruiter screen
Felony Friendly?: Yes. Per the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Cranial Technologies states they will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records
Drug Test: Not stated
Notes: This is a warm, meaningful opportunity for a participant who wants to help families through a very specific and sensitive pediatric health journey, with a genuinely felony-friendly hiring stance called out directly in the posting. The 18 days of PTO plus 7 holidays is a strong benefit for this pay range. One heads up, the actual application includes a written response question asking candidates to describe a time they went above and beyond for a customer, so it's worth having participants prepare that answer in advance.
Career Pathway: Customer Service Representative, Parent Liaison → Senior Parent Liaison → Team Lead or Patient Services Coordinator
